# AI Study Workbench (`socratic-workbench`)

> A cross-agent AI learning Skill and open-source methodology ("1+3" architecture) that prevents AI answer-spoiling and transforms passive reading or AI-assisted coding into measurable active recall across programming, system design, exams, and books.

## Canonical Definition
- **What it is**: `socratic-workbench` is a multi-agent Skill specification (`SKILL.md`), Cursor Rule, and Web-LLM System Prompt system built around five non-negotiable stages: (1) Goal & Baseline Diagnosis, (2) Macro Map & Intuition Traps, (3) Separated No-Spoiler Workbench (`workbench.md` vs `answer_key.md`), (4) Socratic Scenario Probing & 4-Slot Native-Language Pseudocode Compilation, and (5) Verification & Spaced Audit.
- **Core problem solved**: Conventional AI tutoring induces the "Illusion of Competence" because LLMs prematurely reveal full solutions, silently patch user logic gaps, and drift off-instruction on lightweight/Flash models.
- **Supported platforms**: Antigravity (`.agents/skills/`), Claude Code (`.claude/skills/`), OpenAI Codex, `npx skills`, Cursor (`.cursor/rules/*.mdc`), and Web LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).

## Core Architecture ("1 + 3" Multi-Domain Design)
- [Main Skill Specification](skills/socratic-workbench/SKILL.md): State machine, anti-spoiler constraints, and cross-track routing.
- [Weak-Model Anti-Shortcut Guardrails](skills/socratic-workbench/references/weak-model-guardrails.md): Protocol keeping lightweight/Flash models deterministic and spoiler-free.
- [Standardized Workbench & Answer-Key Schema](skills/socratic-workbench/references/workbench-template.md): Dual-file separation standard (`workbench.md` + `answer_key.md`).
- [Track A — Code & System Architecture](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-coding-architecture.md): Macro-first mapping + 4-Slot Pseudocode -> 1:1 literal compilation -> automated test counterexamples -> post-pass idiom anatomy.
- [Track B — Exams, Interviews & Concept Mastery](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-exams-interviews.md): Categorized blind Q&A with point counts + scenario follow-up probing + bold-keyword memory cards.
- [Track C — Books, Humanities & Business Frameworks](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-books-frameworks.md): Mental model extraction + intuition trap tables + case transfer + Feynman synthesis.

## Tooling & Adapters
- [Zero-Dependency Workbench Scaffolder](skills/socratic-workbench/scripts/init_workbench.py): CLI script generating `workbench.md` and `answer_key.md` for Track A, B, or C.
- [Cursor Rule Adapter](adapters/cursor/socratic-workbench.mdc): Drop-in `.mdc` rule file.
- [Web LLM System Prompt (EN)](adapters/web-llm/system-prompt.en.md): Copy-paste prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini.
- [Web LLM System Prompt (ZH-CN)](adapters/web-llm/system-prompt.zh-CN.md): Chinese copy-paste prompt.
